scripts.package: yarn build:css && cd src && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -buildvcs=false -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o ../dist/action-amd64 . && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 go build -buildvcs=false -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o ../dist/action-arm64 .
scripts.test: node --test scripts/*.test.cjs && yarn test:vendor && yarn check:css && yarn readme --check && cd src && go test ./...
scripts.test:coverage: cd src && go test -coverprofile=cover.out ./... && go tool cover -html=cover.out
